title: feat: enable auto-merge on workflow PRs
body:
## Summary
- Add `_gh_enable_auto_merge()` helper — runs `gh pr merge --auto --squash` after PR creation
- Wired into both `workflow finish` and `workflow run`
- Autonomous loop no longer blocks on manual merges when repo has branch protection + auto-merge enabled

## Test plan
- [ ] Lint clean
- [ ] `dtl workflow finish` creates PR and enables auto-merge
- [ ] `dtl workflow run` loop continues after CI-triggered merge
